Speech.NativeText: Hi hon. I'm glad you asked me because I've been thinking... what's our long term plan? We're never really going to be safe here.
{:-| I've heard there are still quarantine zones out there somewhere, with army protection. They've got food, electricity, running water, medical facilities... Maybe it's not true, I don't know.
{:-) But if it is true... hon, what do you say we try and find one? We could have a good life together in a place like that. We could.. have a family.
:-) That's a great idea!
:-( That's just a pipe dream. We need to be realistic.
:-) So glad you're with me!

I've heard you might be able to contact someone by satellite phone. I was given a number once, which I've been saving for the right time. The old terrestrial phone network doesn't work, of course, but satellites are still orbiting. Some of them, anyway. We'd just need a satphone.

If we could contact someone... we might be able to trade some useful equipment with them. They'll have access to the kinds of hardware and resources that our regular traders simply can't get hold of. If we want to take over this area, we'll need that kind of shit!
I'm looking for a satphone...
I haven't come across one.
I'm afraid I can't help you.
I wouldn't know where to find one of those.
Yeah I might know where you can get one.
Hmm, as long as the satellite network hasn't yet succumbed to orbital decay, it should still be quite usable - if you know who to call, of course.
There's a trader by the name of %1 who I've heard can hook you up with one. Won't be cheap.
There's a %1 in %2 by the name of %3 who I've heard might have one. They're looters, watch out!
There's a %1 in %2 by the name of %3 who I've heard might have one. Won't be cheap.
I've been told you can get me a satphone.
Yeah I might be able to, for the right price. To you, that'd be %1 gold.
I'm good for it.
}:-| I can't afford that.
}:-| How about you lend me the phone, because we're such good friends? You don't want me as an enemy do you?
{:-( Uh.. okay. You'll give it back, right?
}:-) Sure I will. Whenever I'm done using it.
}:-[ How about since we're such good friends I'll forget you said that. This time.
}:-[ Don't think you can try that shit on me and get away with it!
}:-| That's a lot of gold. How do I know this thing is even going to work?
Hey, I'm a trustworthy %1, I wouldn't try to rip you off. Do you have the gold or not?

}:-| This phone you sold me doesn't work.
Sorry man, I don't do refunds.
}:-| You're probably just not using it right. Maybe you got the wrong number.
}:-[ I guess you're shit out of luck then aren't you!
That's not my problem.
}:-| Give me back my gold and we'll say no more about this.
Oh okay. Never mind.
{:-| Uh.. you know normally I don't do refunds but I guess I can make an exception just for you.
Take a hike, loser.
}:-| Caveat emptor motherfucker!
I'd need a new number to try.
}:-| This is bullshit - %1 got conned! %2 has got some explaining to do.
}:-| Dammit, this thing doesn't work at all. We're going to need to find another one.
What alternative is there?
}:-) We take over this whole area!
When we're in charge we won't need the military or anyone else to protect us!
You're right, we'll never be truly safe here.
The old terrestrial phone network doesn't work, of course, but satellites are still orbiting. Some of them, anyway. Rumor has it there are still people using satphones.

We already have a satphone. And from what I've heard, people in the safe zones are still using them. I was given a number once, which I've been saving for the right time. The old terrestrial phone network doesn't work, of course, but satellites are still orbiting. We should try and call them!

I want to try and get into a quarantine zone. We've already contacted FEMA so we know they're out there! What do you say we try to join them? We could have a good life, we could help rebuild civilization... and we'd be safe.

Don't throw away the phone just yet, it'd be useful to be in touch with FEMA for trading supplies. They'll have access to the kinds of hardware and resources our regular traders would struggle to get hold of. If we want to take over this area, we'll need that kind of shit!
{:-| We know someone is out there. Let's just hope their intentions are good and they'll accept us.
{:-) I knew you'd be on the same page as me.
We hit the road, and just keep on driving until we find somewhere we can call home.
Take over the area? That sounds... risky. Will people mind, do you think? What if they try to stop us? We should have a backup plan, just in case.
{:-| Take over the area? But we'd do it... ethically, right? I don't want to be evil overlords, just... the good kind. I guess if we're protecting people from looters it's okay.
Hear me out, I think this might still help. You might be able to contact someone by satellite phone. I was given a number once, which I've saved all this time waiting for the right occasion.
}:-) Take over the area? I like your thinking! I'm sick of getting pushed around. But we need to build up our strength.
:-) Just drive away and leave it all behind? That's a plan I could get behind even if all this wasn't going on!
}:-| That sounds kinda irresponsible... what about all the people here? We abandon them? I'll go if you go but I'd rather try to build something for us all.
:-) I like it. There has to be something better out there somewhere for us.

But hear me out, I think this could still help. I've heard rumors the satellite network is still working, if you can find a satphone. And I was given a number to call, which I've been saving for just such an occasion. Apparently they can help us, and if not, well we might be able to trade parts and supplies for our journey.

But don't throw away the phone just yet, it'd be useful to be in touch with FEMA for trading supplies. They'll have access to the kinds of hardware and resources our regular traders would struggle to get hold of. We'll need that for our trip.
:-( I think this thing is just broken. God damn it.
